records.label: OpenWebNet
records.description: Root context for concepts whose meaning is established by the OpenWebNet protocol and its documented interfaces.

records.label: WHO
records.description: Namespace in which WHO selects the functional or management system that gives contextual meaning to other frame fields.

records.label: DIMENSION
records.description: Property namespace whose identifiers are interpreted in at least their WHO context and, for parameterized properties, their selector context.

records.label: WHERE
records.description: System-specific address namespace interpreted only after the applicable interface variant and WHO are resolved.

records.label: Diagnostic protocol
records.description: Management context for discovery, interview, diagnostics, and their Device-scoped selectors and reported state.

records.label: Device model
records.description: Canonical context for Physical Device, Firmware, Module, Object, Configuration, and their catalogue relationships.

records.label: MHCatalogue.db
records.description: Identifier spaces and capability records stored by the canonical MyHOME Suite catalogue database.

records.label: OPEN.db
records.description: Identifier spaces and wire templates stored by the canonical MyHOME Suite OpenWebNet implementation database.

records.label: ScenarioDevices
records.description: Application capability identifiers used by the ScenarioDevices databases; these are independent of catalogue and protocol identifiers.

records.label: Physical Device
records.definition: One installed hardware product instance; catalogue records describe its product model while diagnostic traffic identifies the installed instance.

records.label: Firmware
records.definition: The catalogue layer that projects an item into a concrete set of Modules, supported Objects, configuration properties, and connection modes.

records.label: Module
records.definition: A firmware-exposed logical container within a Physical Device, located by a Device-local slot.

records.label: Object
records.definition: The logical function exposed by or assigned to a Module; it defines what the Module does, not the Physical Device's identity.

records.label: Configuration
records.definition: The set of instance-specific values applied to an Object, Module, firmware, or Device that turns catalogue capability into an operational function.

records.label: slot
records.definition: The numeric Device-local position used by catalogue structures and diagnostic frames to locate a Module; it is not the Module's functional address.

records.label: Installed Device ID
records.definition: A management identifier for one installed Physical Device instance; it is distinct from a catalogue key, SKU, Object identifier, slot, and configured functional address.

records.label: Diagnostic WHERE
records.definition: A field that selects or contextualizes a management response according to its diagnostic family; it does not replace the installed Device ID or a Module's configured address.

records.label: Functional WHERE
records.definition: A runtime target interpreted according to one functional WHO and interface variant; it is not a universal Physical Device identity.

records.label: WHO
records.definition: The frame field that selects the system context in which WHAT, WHERE, and DIMENSION values are interpreted.

records.label: WHAT
records.definition: A command, state, or event identifier whose semantic identity is scoped by WHO.

records.label: DIMENSION
records.definition: A property selector whose identifier, selector parameters, value grammar, and supported operations are scoped by WHO and applicable target context.

records.label: Catalogue Device record
records.description: Entity record for an EN_DEVICE product-model record, kept distinct from an installed Physical Device.

records.label: Physical Device
records.description: Entity record for uses of the Physical Device abstraction; its canonical definition is ownkb:term:physical-device.

records.label: Firmware
records.description: Entity record for uses of the Firmware abstraction; its canonical definition is ownkb:term:firmware.

records.label: Module
records.description: Entity record for uses of the Module abstraction; its canonical definition is ownkb:term:module.

records.label: Object
records.description: Entity record for uses of the Object abstraction; its canonical definition is ownkb:term:object.

records.label: Configuration
records.description: Entity record for uses of the Configuration abstraction; its canonical definition is ownkb:term:configuration.

records.label: Installed Device ID
records.description: Entity record for the management identifier defined by ownkb:term:installed-device-id.

records.label: Diagnostic WHERE
records.description: Entity record for the diagnostic selector defined by ownkb:term:diagnostic-where.

records.label: Functional WHERE
records.description: Entity record for the runtime target defined by ownkb:term:functional-where.

records.label: slot
records.description: Entity record for the Device-local position defined by ownkb:term:slot.

records.label: Physical Device exposes Modules
records.qualification: A Physical Device can expose one or more Modules through its selected firmware.

records.label: Module exposes Object
records.qualification: The Object is assigned to or offered by the Module; alternatives are capability choices, not additional Modules.

records.label: Installed Device ID identifies Physical Device
Installed Device ID differs from Functional WHERE
Installed Device ID differs from Diagnostic WHERE
Numeric equality does not establish identity
records.text: Equal numbers or matching labels in independent protocol, catalogue, implementation, and application namespaces do not establish identity or a join.

records.label: Identity is not address
records.text: An installed Device ID, diagnostic WHERE, and functional WHERE have distinct roles; none may be substituted for another merely because observed values resemble each other.

records.label: slot is not Module or address
records.text: A slot is the numeric position that locates a Module; it is neither the Module itself nor the Module's configured functional address.

records.label: Capability is not runtime state
records.text: Catalogue capability describes what a Device or firmware can support; diagnostic and functional observations describe installed or runtime state and must not be silently substituted for capability.

records.label: WHERE is system-specific
records.text: Resolve the interface variant and WHO before interpreting WHERE; no single universal address grammar applies to every OpenWebNet system.

records.label: Configuration requires resolved context
records.text: A configuration index or value is meaningful only in its resolved Device, firmware, Module, Object, ownership, and operation context.

records.label: Public specification and implementation can differ
records.text: Differences between published protocol documents and versioned implementation artifacts must remain explicit source or version differences, not be silently reconciled.

records.label: Source counts are not protocol limits
records.text: Counts measured in a particular database revision describe that source revision and are not universal protocol maxima or complete product-family counts.

records.label: ZigBee source publication provenance is unresolved
records.text: The supplied ZigBee OpenWebNet specification carries Confidential footers; its public-release provenance remains unresolved even though its interface semantics are used as qualified specification evidence.

records.label: WHO 13 DIMENSION 20 provenance

records.label: WHO 13 DIMENSION 40 semantics

records.label: Diagnostic DIMENSION 32 SYS

records.label: DIMENSION 4 and 5 catalogue correlation
records.text: How do transport positions C1 through C12 correlate, per Device family, with firmware-specific catalogue configuration definitions and physical positions?

records.label: DIMENSION 310 meaning
records.text: What Object- and Device-family-specific meanings and value domains apply to DIMENSION 310?

records.label: Hardware and microcontroller version mapping
records.text: Do hardware and microcontroller version responses select product variants or compatibility, and does an unpreserved source map them to catalogue Devices?

records.label: Address selection and encoding
records.text: What runtime algorithm selects, qualifies, validates, and renders the applicable address rule, including the diagnostic outer WHERE for varying Module layouts?

records.label: Firmware selection precedence
records.text: What MyHOME Suite precedence selects firmware when concrete components, -1 sentinels, build rows, missing builds, defaults, and localization metadata overlap?

records.label: Object replacement rule
records.text: What complete rule determines whether MyHOME Suite displays and permits replacement of an Object at a particular Module?

records.label: Physical-to-advanced correlation boundaries

records.label: Catalogue-wide N_CONF count equivalence
records.text: Does the addressed-form N_CONF database-count equivalence hold for every catalogue firmware, including conditional fields, shared firmware definitions, and Devices without product diagrams?

records.label: Gateway N_CONF 15 semantics
records.text: What exact semantics does N_CONF 15 have in the empty-WHERE gateway identity form?

records.label: Scenario Engine runtime model
records.text: Which database copy and runtime stores, enumerations, event correlations, and matching behaviors implement the Scenario Engine beyond its capability catalogues?

records.label: Application internal control flow
records.text: Which application components execute, cache, synchronize, and interpret the preserved queries, address rules, and localization resources?

records.label: ZigBee source publication provenance
records.text: What publication or distribution provenance permits the supplied ZigBee OpenWebNet specification to be classified as unambiguously public?
